# slate-framework v1.0.0

First stable release of the GPU-first cross-platform UI framework.

macOS + Windows 11 backends green; reactive signals/memos/effects; text shaping
+ IME (CJK on macOS via `NSTextInputClient`, IMM32 on Win32); five publishable
crates with `#![deny(missing_docs)]` workspace-wide; public API frozen via
`cargo-public-api` audit. Wave A → B → C → D closed the pre-v1 debt program
(2026-05-27); Wave E froze the surface, audited licenses + transitive deps,
gated rustdoc, and shipped the 6-run macOS + Win11 example smoke matrix. A1
fine-grained reactivity CUT to v1.x — measured `view_render_pct = 0.011%` on
the worst-case `fine_grained_subscription` scene, two orders of magnitude
below the 10% adopt threshold.

## Crates published

- `slate-reactive` — Signal / Memo / Effect primitives + Runtime dirty-bit coalescing
- `slate-platform` — Window + event-loop abstraction (macOS AppKit, Win32 IMM32)
- `slate-renderer` — wgpu renderer + atlas + layer stack
- `slate-text` — text shaping + rasterization (CoreText / DirectWrite) + BiDi-aware caret
- `slate-framework` — Element system + reactive Div + TextField + TextArea + App loop

## Compatibility notes

- **wgpu.** v1.0.0 builds and tests against `wgpu 29.0.3`. The workspace ships a
  caret constraint (`wgpu = "29.0.3"`); `Cargo.lock` pins the exact patch for
  reproducible builds. v1.x patch releases MAY bump wgpu within the 29.x minor
  after re-running the smoke matrix on macOS + Win11. Cross-minor bumps
  (29 → 30) require a major release.
- **MSRV.** `rustc 1.95.0` (matches workspace `rust-version`).
- **Supported targets.** `aarch64-apple-darwin` (macOS 14+) and
  `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` (Windows 11). Linux is out of scope for v1.0.

## Highlights

- **Reactive core.** `Signal<T>` / `Memo<T>` / `Effect` with runtime dirty-bit
  coalescing; whole-window observer + whole-view rebuild (Strategy A).
- **Text + IME.** UAX#14 line-breaking, BiDi reordering via `unicode-bidi`,
  CJK composition (macOS `NSTextInputClient`, Win32 IMM32), grapheme-aware
  caret motion, multi-rect selection per visual run.
- **TextField + TextArea.** Single-line + multi-line editing with selection,
  clipboard, undo, blinking caret, BiDi-aware visual navigation, IME preedit
  overlay.
- **GPU pipeline.** wgpu-backed renderer with DComp on Windows + Metal on
  macOS; atlas-backed glyph cache with monotonic liveness tokens; deferred
  recovery on device loss with LUID-migration vs callback classification.
- **Profiling harness.** `slate-bench` (workspace-private) drives 4 reference
  scenes with `--features profiling` counter snapshots; bench thresholds
  validated on macOS + Windows 11 hardware.
